title: disperma crenatum
intro: Disperma crenatum, commonly known as Chinese club moss, is a type of lycopod plant that belongs to the family Lycopodiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Disperma crenatum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammation, antipyretic, and antioxidant effects.
